examples.en: Resolving the dispute will require a mood of conciliation on both sides.
examples.zh: 解决这场争端需要双方都抱有和解的态度。

examples.en: A conciliation service helps to settle disputes between employers and workers.
examples.zh: 调解机构帮助解决劳资纠纷。

examples.en: I see here a possible point of conciliation.
examples.zh: 我看到这里可能有一个调解点。
